opening.argument: The speaker's clearest instruction is not to join: he says he will not provide a referral link and tells viewers not to sign up for mining programs. He presents his BitClub mining investment as a loss, then challenges a third party's claim that one Bitcoin could become three or four over a thousand days. He also criticizes making commissions by recruiting family and friends and leaving them holding the bag. His discussion of possible future returns concerns recovering his own Bitcoin; he does not ask viewers to send money or join. These are warnings drawn from his experience, not an invitation to participate.
